items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Eyes Ollin Biosciences, Is It 19% Overvalued?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) is back in focus after reports it is in advanced talks to buy eye drug developer Ollin Biosciences in a deal valued at up to US$3.4b. The Ollin Biosciences headlines land on top of a strong run for Johnson & Johnson, with the share price at US$285.75 and a 30 day share price return of 11.81% contributing to a 37.81% year to date gain.
